criteria.s11: Lock order: Apply takes the key, then Limit, the S3 read and tree.RLock.

criteria.s13: remove still takes RLock, releases it, then takes Lock, with no nesting.

criteria.s15: Each OV request holds a MaxInFlight slot only for itself.
criteria.s16: temp_upload goes through `call`, so it takes a slot and maps 409s.

criteria.s2: Images resolve to D/name/name and go up through temp_upload and an add resource with `to: D/name`.
criteria.s20: Catch-up's want holds D/name/name and have gets it from Walk, while ghost folders are dirs and never count as files.
criteria.s21: The old plain copy D/name: the want loop runs Apply first, which deletes it, and the guard keeps the stale have from removing it.
criteria.s22: Once the image leaves the bucket, the guard no longer fires and catch-up removes the copy like any unwanted file.
criteria.s23: An image at the mapped root works, since the loop covers root/name.png.
